short_description:
[h1]Description[/h1]
Adds many society traits to make your species with.
These new traits are balanced around other vanilla traits.

More traits are planned to be added.
Comment with any balance complaints, bugs, or trait suggestions.

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
File edited:
None. Should be compatible with everything.
